html:
The invasion of Yugoslavia began on 6 April 1941 when Germany, with Italy and Hungary, attacked Yugoslavia after a coup in Belgrade overthrew a government that had just joined the Axis.

German bombers hit Belgrade on the first day, killing thousands. The Yugoslav army collapsed and surrendered within twelve days. The country was carved up: Germany ran Serbia, the Ustaše got a greater Croatia, and Italy, Hungary and Bulgaria took slices. The invasion delayed Germany's attack on the Soviet Union by a few weeks, historians still debate how much. It opened four years of occupation, resistance and civil war in which about a million Yugoslavs died and from which Tito's Partisans emerged victorious.
sum: The invasion of Yugoslavia began on 6 April 1941 when Germany, with Italy and Hungary, attacked Yugoslavia after a coup in Belgrade overthrew a government that had just joined the Axis.
